3fe10187e7b1ac852f544fd9b6f824aa7b7e9aaf57cdc0338292e009bee94105 - IntroActivity: This welcome screen shows a toolbar titled "Welcome" and a scrollable introduction page with several text paragraphs about using lrkFM. A floating action button is also visible for progressing from the introduction.

255e0d8db77d1ce9e53c2f5fd8ed66e3c375955164339147224b43542281afc2 - FileActivity: This file browser screen has a toolbar with a navigation drawer button, the title "emulated," and a more options button. The main content shows an error area stating "Unable to access files 😒" and noting that the directory might also be empty. A floating action button is visible, and the drawer layout indicates navigation can be opened from this screen.

80fb5f189cbea7ec59bf54fa092b75ec7b55450244c52183854325091581014c - null(Window=null): This file browsing screen shows a toolbar with a navigation drawer button, the title "storage," and a more options button. The main area contains a list of storage entries such as "0808-2F10," "emulated," and "self," each with a checkbox, a file or folder icon, permissions text, and a date. A floating action button is also present for an additional file action.

322fee6d2791b7cb6ac7e9adcbc7303e4fc4af31aca6b715a500c1322e2616d8 - null(Window=null): This screen is the Android launcher rather than the lrkFM app. It shows the home workspace with the date, a hotseat containing apps like Messages, Play Store, and Chrome, and an apps list area with a search bar and voice search. The user can browse apps or launch another application from here.

b04de2a8a39c510bf4b8da79cb9d80836e5ccf315061f4693b1bbd7dccf70891 - null(Window=null): This is Chrome's first-run welcome screen with the title "Welcome to Chrome." The screen lets the user review these terms and proceed with Chrome setup.

f88594f3597ef40c0f41d4f8e5095db36cce349c756f860ac3908d81c49ad457 - null(Window=null): This Chrome sign-in choice screen is titled "Sign in to Chrome." It explains that signing in with a Google Account syncs bookmarks, history, passwords, and other settings across devices. Two buttons, "No Thanks" and "Sign in," allow the user to skip or continue with account sign-in.

db04b906179c98c613860900737c666e72d3e3324ea6c1ad09d329c2dd507cad - null(Window=null): This Android permission dialog asks, "Allow lrkFM to access photos and media on your device?" 227a781df4ae7cc69c7b7f74265dfe02d13a24c5ce6cdce4c6280ea53d0da672 - GrantPermissionsActivity: This permission dialog asks, "Allow lrkFM to access photos, media, and files on your device?"
